title: Cooperation with Foreign Jurisdictions to Disrupt Cross-border Vape Supply Chains
what_it_is: Cooperation with Foreign Jurisdictions to Disrupt Cross-border Vape Supply Chains

sections.label: E-vaporiser smuggling and online enforcement
sections.summary: HSA and ICA detected 59 large-scale smuggling cases in 2025, seizing around 230,000 e-vaporisers, while over 10,000 online advertisements were removed in 2024 and 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health):
sentences.text: With the help of intelligence sharing, in 2025, joint operations between the Health Sciences Authority (HSA) and ICA detected 59 large-scale smuggling cases, seizing around 230,000 e-vaporisers and related products.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health):
sentences.text: HSA works with e-commerce, social media and messaging platforms to remove online listings of e-vaporisers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health):
sentences.text: HSA also collaborates with the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) and the Online Criminal Harms Act Office under SPF to block e-vaporiser websites targeting locals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health):
sentences.text: Over 10,000 online advertisements, including those found on messaging platforms, were removed in 2024 and 2025.

sections.label: Daily bot surveillance of commercial sites
sections.summary: Surveillance is done daily with bots to target commercial sites and identify offending sites that need to be taken down.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: On a daily basis, there is a surveillance done with bots to target commercial sites, to trawl and see what other sites that are offending that we need to take down.

sections.label: Blocking vape commercial sites
sections.summary: After offending sites are taken down, work continues with IMDA, SPF and the Online Criminal Harms Acts Office to block specific vape commercial sites.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Once the offending sites are taken down, we will work together with IMDA, SPF and the Online Criminal Harms Acts Office to block specific vape commercial sites.
